scope: Local application and synthetic MCP/Workers; no live tests or deployment

checks.name: App release build and three pinned Worker dry builds
Packaged task skill, changed prose and whitespace validation

acceptance_evidence: Thirty neutral query/page cases agree across C#, TypeScript and the actual local Workspace Worker, preserving document order and all-state defaults.
Combined text/notes and exact metadata filters enforce inclusive civil dates, direct-category precedence, absent-date exclusion and explicit mapping-state limits.
Unicode cases cover fullwidth normalization, decomposed accents, dotted-character expansion and Greek final sigma without accent stripping.
Bounded continuation requires the preceding document revision; changed revisions reject explicitly. Both pure services preserve the input document.
Synthetic MCP advertises read-only combined filters under tasks:read. Missing grants are denied at MCP and the private service; another profile sees no matching task.
Queries create no commands/preparations and issue zero upstream writes.
limitations: Saved views, review/staleness policies, reminders, next-action queries and mobile filter UI remain Pending.
Linked mapping remains distinct from original command effect confirmation.
Actual host discovery, device qualification and live behavior remain unrun.
